sloka: पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षौ खड्ग तूणी धनुर् धरौ ।अश्विनौ इव रूपेण समुपस्थित यौवनौ ॥१-४८-३॥
transliteration: padma patra viśālākṣau khaḍga tūṇī dhanur dharau ।aśvinau iva rūpeṇa samupasthita yauvanau ॥1-48-3॥

translations.english: "O Sage, wish you well Who are these two youths who seem to possess the prowess of celestial beings. They walk with the gait of an elephant or a lion. They are courageous like tiger or a bull. Their large eyes are like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars, bows and quivers. They are young and handsome like Aswinikumaras dropped from heaven casually. Whose sons are they? How did they come here on foot? With what purpose?
translations.hindi: मैं तपस्या करूँगी। आप मुझे ऐसा गर्भ दीजिए जिसमें बल- चान्‌ , महाविजयी, दृढ़ बुद्धि वाला, समदर्शी
